title: Completion-unit normalization of scalar adjunction and pullback reconstruction
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring, $I$ a finitely generated ideal, $A/I$ additive torsion, and $P_n=A/I^n$ finite and perfect over $A$ for every $n\geq1$. For a scheme $T$, use its small pro-etale site, the constant ring sheaves $\underline A_T$, $\underline{P_n}_T$, and $A_T=\varprojlim_n\underline{P_n}_T$, with canonical scalar map $\underline A_T\to A_T$ and quotient projections [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. All sites are small in [def-weil-size-convention]. Write $D(A_T)$ and $D(\underline A_T)$ for unbounded derived module categories and $r_T$ for restriction along this scalar map [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Let $J=\mathbf N_{\geq1}^{op}$, $\Delta$ be its constant-diagram functor, and $Q_T=(\underline{P_n}_T)_n$ with quotient transitions. On the ringed diagram site [lem-weil-pbc-diagram-site-realization], define $\mathcal R_T^aL=\Delta L\otimes^L_{\Delta A_T}Q_T$ and $\mathcal R_T^0L_0=\Delta L_0\otimes^L_{\Delta\underline A_T}Q_T$. These are actual derived strict towers. For an edge $u:U\to V$ use the canonical coefficient isomorphisms $u^{-1}A_V\cong A_U$, $u^{-1}\underline{P_n}_V\cong\underline{P_n}_U$ [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-coefficient-inverse-image], the ordinary ringed operations $L_u^a\dashv R_u^a$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], their strict-diagram operations $\mathscr L_u^a\dashv\mathscr R_u^a$, and the constant-coefficient counterparts $G_u\dashv R_u^0$ and $G_u\dashv R_u^{\mathcal T}$. Let $a_u:r_UL_u^a\cong G_ur_V$, $\chi_u:r_VR_u^a\cong R_u^0r_U$, $p_u:r_U\mathscr L_u^a\cong G_ur_V$ and $d_u:r_V\mathscr R_u^a\cong R_u^{\mathcal T}r_U$ be the normalized flat scalar comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-flat-ringed-diagram-restriction].

Put $\mathcal L_T^a=R\lim$ on completed-coefficient strict towers and $\mathcal L_T^0=R\lim$ on constant-coefficient strict towers. Let $\lambda_Z:r_T\mathcal L_T^aZ\cong\mathcal L_T^0r_TZ$ be the compatible-family/K-injective comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-flat-scalar-tower-limit-square], and let $\rho_L$ and $q_{u,L}=(G_u\rho_L)p_{u,\mathcal R_V^aL}$ be the strict balancing and pullback comparisons of [lem-weil-pbc-strict-quotient-scalar-balancing]. Derived completeness means invertibility of the canonical quotient completion unit; its equivalence with Koszul completeness is fixed by [prop-weil-pbc-koszul-reconstruction]. Restriction identifies the two full complete categories [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]. Define $F_u^a$ as ordinary pullback followed by quotient completion [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback], and $F_u^0=(\mathcal L_U^0\mathcal R_U^0)G_u$ on constant complete inputs [lem-sp-completed-pullback-adjunction]. Denote their completion units from ordinary pullback by $j^a_{u,L}:L_u^aL\to F_u^aL$ and $j^0_{u,r_VL}:G_ur_VL\to F_u^0r_VL$, and their fixed quotient reconstruction isomorphisms by
$$r_{u,L}:F_u^aL\cong\mathcal L_U^a\mathscr L_u^a\mathcal R_V^aL,\quad r^0_{u,r_VL}:F_u^0r_VL\cong\mathcal L_U^0G_u\mathcal R_V^0r_VL.$$

There is a unique natural isomorphism $\phi_u:r_UF_u^a\cong F_u^0r_V$ on the full complete category satisfying $\phi_{u,L}r_U(j^a_{u,L})=j^0_{u,r_VL}a_{u,L}$. Its normalization is
$$\mathcal L_U^0(q_{u,L})\lambda_{\mathscr L_u^a\mathcal R_V^aL}\,r_U(r_{u,L})=r^0_{u,r_VL}\phi_{u,L}.$$
Moreover restriction identifies the actual quotient completion units: under $\lambda$ and $\rho$, $r_T(L\to\mathcal L_T^a\mathcal R_T^aL)$ equals the constant quotient completion unit of $r_TL$, for every ambient $L$.

The comparison $\phi_u$, together with $\chi_u$, identifies the adjunctions $F_u^a\dashv R_u^a$ and $F_u^0\dashv R_u^0$: their Hom bijections are precisely precomposition by $j^a$ or $j^0$, followed by the ordinary derived adjunction. It therefore identifies their units and counits and the completed pullback composition and identity maps defined as adjunction conjugates of direct-image composition and identity [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate]. The displayed reconstruction equality is natural in every morphism between complete inputs and under any isomorphism $r_VL\cong L_0$ of constant complete objects, with its induced strict reduction and completed-pullback maps. Direct image preserves completeness [prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits], so the assertions apply also to $L=R_f^aK$ for complete $K$, with no properness, boundedness, constructibility or etale-origin condition.

Naturality of lambda and the strict balancing equation prove the fixed reconstruction identity. The quotient-unit identity proves unit normalization. Precomposition with the constant quotient unit is injective into a complete object, proving uniqueness.

split_report.summary: Split using existing nodes only. Compute preservation of the constant/limit map on a K-injective tower, then use the strict augmentation and pullback balancing equalities to identify quotient units and the fixed reconstruction maps. Derive uniqueness, completed Hom-bijection compatibility, units/counits and conjugate composition maps from the existing completion reflector and ordinary scalar adjunction comparison. No ambient full faithfulness or completeness of ordinary pullback is assumed.

lean.statement: theorem completedScalarUnitAdjunction (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (B : Balancing d) : ∃ H : CompletionFacts d, (∀ T : Scheme.{u}, (H.restriction T).IsEquivalence) ∧ ∃ lambda : ∀ T : Scheme.{u}, rlim (ring T d true) ⋙ dres (scalar T d) ≅ tdres (scalar T d) ⋙ rlim (ring T d false), (∀ T : Scheme.{u}, LimitNormalized T d (lambda T)) ∧ (∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (L : D (ring T d true)), (dres (scalar T d)).map ((completionUnit (topology T) A d.ideal true).app L) ≫ (completionComparison d B T (lambda T)).hom.app L = (completionUnit (topology T) A d.ideal false).app ((dres (scalar T d)).obj L)) ∧ (∀ (U V : Scheme.{u}) (f : U ⟶ V), Nonempty (Operations d B f)) ∧ ∀ (U V : Scheme.{u}) (f : U ⟶ V) (O : Operations d B f), Nonempty (Comparison O H (lambda U))
